description: This file implements the deletion logic for email records within the SuiteCRM application. It handles retrieving a specific email record, verifying user permissions, marking the record as deleted, and redirecting the user accordingly.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks an email record as deleted.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Fetches the email record by its ID.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has delete permissions on the email record.
